title: 10 Best Agastache Rugosa Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Agastache rugosa are teas, decoctions, tinctures, mucillages, and creams, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Teas made from its dried leaves and flowers are commonly used to soothe digestive issues and promote respiratory health. Decoctions, prepared by boiling the herb, are valued for their potency in treating colds and sore throats. Tinctures provide a concentrated form, ideal for addressing inflammation and infections. Mucillages and creams harness its soothing properties, making them effective for skin irritations and oral care.
